svg.title: Chatham VII: Black White
svg.desc: Interpretive vector after actual visual inspection. Approximate contours and interpretive screen colors. Chatham VII identified by Foundation EK458 caption in four-work installation view; center work nearly frontal. Approximate panel ratios, no inferred physical dimensions. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for black, white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://ellsworthkelly.org/exhibition/ellsworth-kelly-chatham-series/; inspected 2026-10-27; interpretive study, not a facsimile.
